conditions.rendering: Headless system Chromium, sandbox enabled, software WebGL (SwiftShader).
conditions.sampling: Six pairs, alternating baseline/redesign and redesign/baseline; fresh context for each load in one reused browser process; no other QA browsers running.
conditions.network: Live OpenFreeMap via session HTTPS proxy; no throttling. Provider and OS caches uncontrolled. Each version uses its shipped initial camera and canvas/layout.
conditions.resource_caveat: Resource Timing transfer sizes can be zero for cross-origin resources without Timing-Allow-Origin; observable bytes are not total wire bytes. JS heap is a coarse Chromium estimate, not GPU or total process memory.
